propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because the test does not control optional metric-tool availability
the 50-LOC fixture is below the 800-LOC metric threshold, so when a metric tool is present on PATH, _metric_invoke returns no match and emits no metric coverage record
the test asserts that the metric backend is always present in reconstructed coverage, but production behavior correctly omits a record when an optional tool matches nothing above threshold

the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already forces _METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing binary to achieve host-independent behavior, but test_full_backend_account_is_present missed this control
applying the same fixture control pattern (forcing _METRIC_CANDIDATES to missing) makes the test deterministic and produces the expected skipped coverage record with reason=no_tool on all hosts
